apps.title: Family Healthcare Costs
apps.q: CHIA high out-of-pocket burden for Massachusetts families.
apps.heritage: New. The Tableau suite did not publish the Massachusetts Health Insurance Survey as a namesake.
apps.scope: This ledger reports the 2025 Massachusetts Health Insurance Survey for residents and their families: the CHIA high out-of-pocket-to-income ratio, the published share-of-income distribution, any family affordability issue, problems paying medical bills, family medical debt, unmet need due to cost, insurance coverage at the time of the survey, and the high-deductible share among the privately insured. apps.exclusions: Does not publish an average dollar out-of-pocket cost; MHIS does not print that cell.
